body.statement: For every factual cell \(v\) and raw explicit unnested conjunction \(\gamma\), first compute \(\gamma^{\circ}=\mathsf N(\gamma)\) and its normalized context set \(\mathcal H\), and let \(h=|\mathcal H|\). Set \(r=1\), \(\gamma_1^{\circ}=\gamma^{\circ}\), \(c_1=1\), and \(g=g_{\gamma^{\circ}}\), where \(g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f)=\mathbf 1\{\gamma^{\circ}(f)\}\). Under this coefficient convention, \(\ell_g(v)=\min_{f\in F_v}g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f)\), \(u_g(v)=\max_{f\in F_v}g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f)\), \(L_g(p)=\sum_{v\in\mathcal X}p(v)\ell_g(v)\), and \(U_g(p)=\sum_{v\in\mathcal X}p(v)u_g(v)\). The compiler \(\mathsf C_1\) decides whether some \(f\in F_v\) satisfies \(\gamma^{\circ}\), and returns a sparse witness when one exists, in \(B_h3^{(h-1)/3}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}})\) time including normalization. A false self-intervention truth constant produced by \(\mathsf N\) makes the conjunction identically false. Otherwise a retained atom \(V_{i,I}=y\) is true for every \(f\in F_v\) if and only if \( |\mathcal D_i|=1\), or \(I\) agrees with \(v\) and \(v_i=y\); hence the conjunction's false bit is decided by a linear scan of normalized constants and retained atoms. By the canonical-carrier equivalence, the endpoints \(L_g(p)\) and \(U_g(p)\) are sharp over the standard parent-subset class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ord}}\), and total sparse-input time is \(sB_h3^{(h-1)/3}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}})\) after charging dense or sparse input reading. On the same order-only class and conjunction target, these endpoints equal those of Rossetto--Antonucci, while the sparse-input construction strictly replaces their completed-signature alphabet-product quotient by an \(h\)-parameter transition system.
body.justification: The theorem gives an exact sharp-bound routine whose exponential factor depends on the normalized world count rather than alphabet cardinality.
body.gap: Rossetto--Antonucci's exact lifted program retains an alphabet-product optimization space; this theorem is a strict computational tightening on the same order-only model and conjunction target.
body.consumer: Sharp probabilities of necessity, sufficiency, and other explicit multi-world conjunctions become tractable when the normalized number of contexts is small even with many-valued variables.
body.proof_tex:
By \texttt{lem:query-normalization}, computing \(\gamma^{\circ}=\mathsf N(\gamma)\) preserves its truth for every \(f\) and costs \(O(N_{\mathrm{in}})\).  Under the stated convention \(r=1\), \(c_1=1\), the definition of \(A_v\) gives
\[
 A_v=\{(g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f)):f\in F_v\}\subseteq\{0,1\},
\]
and hence, by \texttt{def:cell-labels},
\[
 \ell_g(v)=\min_{f\in F_v}g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f),
 \qquad
 u_g(v)=\max_{f\in F_v}g_{\gamma^{\circ}}(f).
\]
Every \(F_v\) is nonempty: set \(f_i(v_{<i})=v_i\) for every \(i\) and extend all other rows by arbitrary values from the nonempty alphabets.

The dynamic program starts at \(\pi_0=\{\mathcal H\}\), applies \(\mathsf C_1\)'s representative transitions, and merges equal successor partitions.  By \texttt{lem:representative-transition} and induction over the coordinates, its states are exactly the partitions having a feasible partial response system satisfying all pins processed so far.  Thus it has an accepting terminal state if and only if some \(f\in F_v\) satisfies \(\gamma^{\circ}\).  A predecessor pointer and selected representative column on the first edge entering each state recover an accepting path.  At each coordinate, record the selected output once for every distinct natural predecessor tuple encountered on that path.  Soundness of the transition rule makes repeated rows consistent, there are at most \(h\) rows per coordinate, and assigning an arbitrary alphabet default on every unlisted tuple produces \(\widehat f\in\mathfrak F\).  Ordered induction shows that it reproduces the stored columns.  Thus the witness has at most \(kh\) stored rows and one default per coordinate.

There are at most \(B_h\) partitions at a layer, at most \(3^{(h-1)/3}\) representative column choices from each state, and \(k\), alphabet scans, pin checks, canonical partition encoding, and traceback are polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{in}}\).  Therefore the decision and witness time is
\[
 B_h3^{(h-1)/3}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}).
\]

For completeness, we derive the false bit rather than infer it from failure of separate atom tests.  Let \(A=\{V_{i,I}=y\}\) be a retained atom, so \(i\notin\operatorname{dom}(I)\) and every intervention coordinate precedes \(i\).  Then
\[
 \bigl(\forall f\in F_v:\ E(f,I)_i=y\bigr)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 |\mathcal D_i|=1
 \ \text{or}\ 
 \bigl(I(t)=v_t\text{ for all }t\in\operatorname{dom}(I)\text{ and }v_i=y\bigr).
\]
If \(|\mathcal D_i|=1\), validity of the input forces \(y\) to be its sole value.  If \(I\) agrees with \(v\), induction below \(i\) using \texttt{def:ordered-evaluation} gives \(E(f,I)_{<i}=v_{<i}\) for every \(f\in F_v\), and therefore \(E(f,I)_i=f_i(v_{<i})=v_i\).  These prove the reverse implication and the agreeing case.

For the remaining direction, suppose \(|\mathcal D_i|>1\).  If \(I\) agrees with \(v\) but \(v_i\neq y\), every member of \(F_v\) falsifies the atom.  If \(I\) disagrees with \(v\), its first disagreeing intervention coordinate makes \(E(f,I)_{<i}\neq v_{<i}\), irrespective of later choices.  Select \(z\in\mathcal D_i\setminus\{y\}\), prescribe the factual rows \(f_t(v_{<t})=v_t\), prescribe arbitrary consistent rows along the \(I\)-world through coordinate \(i-1\), and set
\[
 f_i(E(f,I)_{<i})=z,
 \qquad
 f_i(v_{<i})=v_i.
\]
The two arguments are distinct, so these prescriptions are consistent, and sparse-response completion extends them to an \(f\in F_v\) falsifying the atom.  The displayed equivalence follows.

A false truth constant from normalization makes the whole conjunction identically false.  Otherwise, if every retained atom satisfies the right-hand side of the equivalence, all are true for every \(f\in F_v\), so \(\ell_g(v)=1\).  If at least one does not, the construction for that one supplies an \(f\in F_v\) that falsifies the conjunction, so \(\ell_g(v)=0\).  Thus a single linear scan computes the false bit; it does not require one response system that falsifies all atoms.  The empty conjunction has both labels one.  The true bit is exactly the accepting-state decision already proved.

It remains to relate the cell calculations to the causal target.  For any compatible canonical law \(\mu\), observational compatibility and the partition of \(\mathfrak F\) into the fibres \(F_v\) give
\[
 \theta_g
 =\sum_{v\in\mathcal X}\sum_{f\in F_v}\mu(f)g(f),
 \qquad
 \sum_{f\in F_v}\mu(f)=p(v).
\]
Since \(\ell_g(v)\leq g(f)\leq u_g(v)\) on \(F_v\), multiplication by \(\mu(f)\geq0\) and summation yield
\[
 L_g(p)=\sum_vp(v)\ell_g(v)
 \leq\theta_g\leq
 \sum_vp(v)u_g(v)=U_g(p).
\]
For each positive-mass cell choose a minimizing, respectively maximizing, response system supplied by the preceding constructions, and put exogenous mass \(p(v)\) on that system.  Its factual law is \(p\), and its expected score is exactly the corresponding endpoint.  Zero-mass cells require no choice.  Convexly mixing the two compatible endpoint laws preserves \(p\) and fills the interval.  By \texttt{prop:canonical-carrier-equivalence}, the same sharp interval holds over \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ord}}\).  The Rossetto--Antonucci comparison in the statement is extensional: their named order-only cell extrema and the displayed extrema optimize the same response fibres after this canonical equivalence, so their endpoint values coincide; no additional identifying premise is used.  The construction above never enumerates a completed response signature: its only exponential state and transition factors are \(B_h\) and \(3^{(h-1)/3}\), while every alphabet operation is a charged polynomial scan.  It is therefore the stated \(h\)-parameter replacement of the completed-signature alphabet-product quotient on the same cells.

For sparse input, running the cell procedure only on the \(s\) listed positive-mass cells costs
\[
 sB_h3^{(h-1)/3}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}),
\]
in addition to the already charged input scan.  For dense input, reading all supplied cells is itself included in \(N_{\mathrm{in}}\).  This proves the claimed representation-sensitive runtime without treating an unobserved sample cell as a structural zero.
